hq.name: Headquarters
hq.info: Your first store (60 of each good), your people and your last stand.

forester.name: Forester
forester.info: Plants trees on open land nearby.

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.info: Cuts rocks or granite within 4 tiles.

charcoal_burner.name: Charcoal burner
charcoal_burner.info: Burns logs slowly under turf into charcoal: the fuel for bronze, copper and bricks, and later for gunpowder.

fisher.name: Fisher
fisher.info: Needs water with fish within 3 tiles.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.info: Needs a large forest within 8 tiles. Also yields hides.

farm.name: Farm
farm.info: Sows up to 6 fields on open grass around it and harvests them when ripe (a minute of growing, faster in summer). Wheat at first, more seeds through research: choose what it sows below.

orchard.name: Orchard
orchard.info: Apples. Cheap food that fills slowly.

pig_farm.name: Pig farm
pig_farm.info: Grain and water into meat and hides.

smokehouse.name: Smokehouse
smokehouse.info: Smoked fish is the most filling food.

brewery.name: Brewery
brewery.info: Beer keeps artisans and nobles content.

coal_mine.name: Coal mine
coal_mine.info: On a coal deposit. Miners eat.

iron_mine.name: Iron mine
iron_mine.info: On an iron deposit. Miners eat.

gold_mine.name: Gold mine
gold_mine.info: On a gold deposit. Miners eat.

copper_mine.name: Copper mine
copper_mine.info: On a copper deposit. Miners eat.

tin_mine.name: Tin mine
tin_mine.info: On a tin deposit: tin is rare, and bronze needs it. Miners eat.

brickworks.name: Brickworks
brickworks.info: Clay fired with charcoal into bricks.

iron_smelter.name: Iron smelter
iron_smelter.info: Iron ore and coal into iron.

copper_smelter.name: Copper smelter
copper_smelter.info: Copper ore and charcoal into copper.

bronze_foundry.name: Bronze foundry
bronze_foundry.info: Copper and tin ore melted together over charcoal: bronze, the metal of the age.

mint.name: Mint
mint.info: Gold ore and coal into gold.

toolsmith.name: Toolsmith
toolsmith.info: Makes the tool each trade needs, whichever is wanted most: tools that buildings are waiting for first, then those below their production target.

bronze_smith.name: Bronze smith
bronze_smith.info: Casts and hammers bronze into the tool each trade needs, whichever is wanted most.

bronze_weaponsmith.name: Bronze weaponsmith
bronze_weaponsmith.info: Bronze spearheads, axes and swords for the barracks.

bowyer.name: Bowyer
bowyer.info: Makes bows from wood. A military building's soldiers take up bows (set Archers in its info box): archers shoot at attackers from 6 tiles out but are weaker in a fight at the gate.

bronze_armorer.name: Bronze armourer
bronze_armorer.info: Bronze breastplates and greaves: veteran soldiers fight better in them.

flax_farm.name: Flax farm
flax_farm.info: Grows flax for linen clothes. A crop: best in summer, slow in winter.

linen_weaver.name: Linen weaver
linen_weaver.info: Flax into light linen clothes for the summer heat.

furrier.name: Furrier
furrier.info: Hides into warm fur coats for the winter. Hunters and pig farms bring hides.

jeweller.name: Jeweller
jeweller.info: Gold and copper into jewelry for nobles.

lodge.name: Workers' lodge
lodge.info: Up to 12 idle workers wait here instead of at headquarters, so they are close at hand when a building nearby needs one, and builders and new workers have a short walk.

school.name: School
school.info: A teacher trains a peasant into an artisan.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.info: Turns an artisan into a soldier. Armor in store makes a veteran.

manor.name: Manor
manor.info: Raises an artisan to noble. Nobles pay tax in gold.

herb_garden.name: Herb garden
herb_garden.info: Grows healing herbs. A crop: slow in winter, best in wetlands.

apothecary.name: Apothecary
apothecary.info: Herbs into medicine. Medicine in store cures the sick slowly at home.

infirmary.name: Infirmary
infirmary.info: Healers cure 8 sick people per medicine. Works only while somebody is sick.

bathhouse.name: Bathhouse
bathhouse.info: Keeps 50 people clean while it works: fewer outbreaks of dysentery, plague and other diseases.

tavern.name: Tavern
tavern.info: Serves beer and bread to the homes within 9 tiles: people there are more content, and content people work faster. With beer and bread to spare it holds a festival now and then: everyone works 10% faster for 3 minutes.

chapel.name: Chapel
chapel.info: Calms the homes within 10 tiles: people there are more content, and content people work faster. Burns candles.

fire_station.name: Fire station
fire_station.info: Its crew of three runs with buckets to any fire within 14 tiles (wells nearby send one person each). Fires spread between wooden buildings.

boundary_stone.name: Boundary stone
boundary_stone.info: Claims free land 4 tiles around it without any soldiers. It holds only land nobody's soldiers hold: when a rival's military building reaches its land, that land is theirs and the stone falls. Good for filling gaps and pushing into empty country cheaply.

palisade.name: Palisade
palisade.info: A ring of stakes round a blockhouse: the cheapest, quickest way to claim land. Claims 5 tiles, holds 1 soldier. All wood, no stone.

guardhouse.name: Guardhouse
guardhouse.info: A stout stone guardhouse. Claims 7 tiles, holds 3. Its walls help the defenders (+3% a duel).

keep.name: Keep
keep.info: A walled stone keep. Claims 11 tiles, holds 6. Thick walls (+5% a duel for its defenders).

castle.name: Castle
castle.info: Claims 13 tiles. Holds 8. Needs a noble.

scout_lodge.name: Scout lodge
scout_lodge.info: Trains peasants as scouts, with bread and a bow. Scouts man watch towers and explore the map (Send scout).

watch_tower.name: Watch tower
watch_tower.info: A tall wooden lookout. With a scout inside it lifts the fog of war 14 tiles around. It claims no land.

library.name: Library
library.info: Monastic library. Twice a scriptorium's research.

paper_mill.name: Paper mill
paper_mill.info: Logs and water into paper for universities.

university.name: University
university.info: Paper and beer into a lot of research.

bastion.name: Star fort
bastion.info: A low, angled star fort built to shrug off cannon. Claims 14 tiles, holds 10. Walls +8% a duel, and its cannon fire on attackers 6 tiles out. Its guns fire only with gunpowder in store (one charge a volley).

battery.name: Gun battery
battery.info: An earthwork with cannon. Claims 8 tiles, holds 5. Its guns fire on attackers from 8 tiles out, every 4 seconds, while it has a crew. Its guns fire only with gunpowder in store (one charge a volley).

redoubt.name: Armoured redoubt
redoubt.info: Brick and iron casemates with breech-loading guns. Claims 16 tiles, holds 16. Walls +8% a duel; its guns fire on attackers 9 tiles out every 3 seconds. Its guns fire only with gunpowder in store (one charge a volley).

machine_works.name: Machine works
machine_works.info: Steam-powered smithy: weapons and the tools most wanted.

textile_mill.name: Textile mill
textile_mill.info: Steam looms: cloth and clothes from wool.

storehouse.name: Storehouse
storehouse.info: Tier 1 store: room for 40 more of each good and 6 more porters. Carriers deliver to the nearest store, so outposts work faster.

market.name: Market
market.info: Trade with realms at peace with you (Diplomacy window). Carts carry the goods from your market to theirs, and theirs back, so a trade takes a while; goods on the way are lost if war breaks out. A small store too.

warehouse.name: Warehouse
warehouse.info: Tier 2 store: room for 120 more of each good and 12 more porters.

depot.name: Great depot
depot.info: Tier 3 store: room for 300 more of each good and 20 more porters.

mule_station.name: Mule station
mule_station.info: Keeps 6 pack mules fed with grain. Mules carry 3 goods at a time, faster than porters, for buildings within 10 tiles.

cart_yard.name: Ox cart yard
cart_yard.info: Builds and repairs 4 ox carts that carry 6 goods at a time for buildings within 12 tiles.

sand_pit.name: Sand pit
sand_pit.info: Digs sand near the water, for glassworks.

apiary.name: Apiary
apiary.info: Bees make honey (food) and beeswax for candles.

cheesery.name: Cheesery
cheesery.info: Milk and salt into cheese, a rich food that keeps.

butcher.name: Butcher
butcher.info: Meat and salt into sausages: more food from the same meat.

winery.name: Winery
winery.info: Wine: nobles prefer it, and it serves artisans as well as beer.

chandler.name: Chandler
chandler.info: Beeswax into candles; nobles want candles or glassware.

glassworks.name: Glassworks
glassworks.info: Sand and coal into glassware; nobles want glassware or candles.

catapult.name: Catapult
catapult.info: Throws a stone every 24 s at the nearest enemy military building within 10 tiles, while you are at war with its realm. Each hit kills a defender about one time in three, so a strong fort can be worn down before your soldiers go in. Uses 1 stone a shot.

donkey_farm.name: Donkey farm
donkey_farm.info: Breeds donkeys from grain and water (only in games with road carriers). Each donkey in store helps the carrier on one busy stretch of road.

harbour.name: Harbour
harbour.info: A store on the coast. Expeditions sail from here to found a colony on another shore (a ship, 4 planks, 2 stone and a soldier), and ships carry goods between your harbours that no road joins. Holds a little land, a soldier, and 8 people.

shipyard.name: Shipyard
shipyard.info: Builds a ship from 4 planks every work cycle, up to 6 ships. Ships sail expeditions and carry goods between harbours.

great_hall.name: Great hall
great_hall.info: A wonder of the Early Medieval age: the king's hall, where lords feast and swear their oaths. Built once by each realm; while it stands: gold tax +10%, newcomers arrive +10% faster. The first realm with all five wonders wins (when the research victory is on).

cathedral.name: Cathedral
cathedral.info: A wonder of the High Medieval age: its spire is seen from every village. Built once by each realm; while it stands: artisans and nobles use -8% goods, newcomers arrive +15% faster. The first realm with all five wonders wins (when the research victory is on).

grand_academy.name: Grand academy
grand_academy.info: A wonder of the Renaissance: scholars from every land come to teach and learn. Built once by each realm; while it stands: research +20%. The first realm with all five wonders wins (when the research victory is on).

observatory.name: Observatory
observatory.info: A wonder of the Enlightenment: the heavens measured, and the seasons, tides and maps with them. Built once by each realm; while it stands: research +10%, all production +5% speed. The first realm with all five wonders wins (when the research victory is on).

exhibition_palace.name: Exhibition palace
exhibition_palace.info: A wonder of the Industrial age: a palace of iron and glass showing the realm's machines and goods. Built once by each realm; while it stands: all production +8% speed, gold tax +10%. The first realm with all five wonders wins (when the research victory is on).

mulberry_grove.name: Mulberry grove
mulberry_grove.info: Silkworms fed on mulberry leaves spin their cocoons. A crop: slow in winter.

silk_weaver.name: Silk weaver
silk_weaver.info: Reels the cocoons and weaves silk: a luxury nobles pay well for.

pepper_garden.name: Pepper garden
pepper_garden.info: Pepper vines and saffron beds, from seeds the explorers brought home. A crop.

spice_mill.name: Spice mill
spice_mill.info: Grinds and blends peppercorns with salt into spices: a luxury for nobles.

porcelain_kiln.name: Porcelain kiln
porcelain_kiln.info: Fires kaolin white and hard and paints it blue: porcelain, a luxury for nobles.

coffee_plantation.name: Coffee plantation
coffee_plantation.info: Coffee bushes heavy with red cherries. A crop: slow in winter.

coffee_roaster.name: Coffee roaster
coffee_roaster.info: Roasts and grinds the beans: coffee, a luxury nobles and artisans love.

naval_yard.name: Naval yard
naval_yard.info: Builds warships. They guard the coast near your harbours, chase enemy warships, fire on landing fleets that come near and sink enemy cargo ships, and sail with your landings to shield them.

coastal_fort.name: Coastal fort
coastal_fort.info: A fort on the shore with guns: while it holds soldiers, it fires on enemy warships, landing fleets and cargo ships within 7 tiles. Its guns fire only with gunpowder in store (one charge a volley).

field_depot.name: Field depot
field_depot.info: Keeps rations for your armies: carriers fill it with food, and an army that attacks a building within 14 tiles of it eats from it at the gate, as if it fought near home.

river_landing.name: River landing
river_landing.info: A small store on a river or lake, with a boat. When two of your landings lie on the same water and the way between them by road is long (or there is none), the boat carries goods across: from where there is plenty to where there is little, up to 6 at a time. Boats stay in in a storm.

sulfur_mine.name: Sulfur mine
sulfur_mine.info: On a sulfur deposit (yellow on the mountains, found by a geologist). Miners eat. Sulfur goes into gunpowder.

saltpeter_works.name: Saltpeter works
saltpeter_works.info: Leaches saltpeter out of the earth of stables and middens and boils it down over a wood fire.

powder_mill.name: Powder mill
powder_mill.info: Grinds saltpeter, sulfur and charcoal together into gunpowder, wet, so nothing goes up. Cannon forts, coastal forts, gunsmiths and naval yards need it.

gunsmith.name: Gunsmith
gunsmith.info: Muskets and their powder: iron, wood and gunpowder into weapons, twice what a weaponsmith makes.

lead_mine.name: Lead mine
lead_mine.info: On a lead deposit (grey-blue on the mountains, found by a geologist). Miners eat.

lead_smelter.name: Lead smelter
lead_smelter.info: Lead melts easily: a coal fire turns lead ore into bars of lead.

cartridge_works.name: Cartridge works
cartridge_works.info: Casts lead balls and wraps them with a charge of gunpowder: cartridges for musketeers and riflemen, who cannot fire without them.

pyrotechnist.name: Pyrotechnist
pyrotechnist.info: Sulfur, saltpeter and charcoal, with metal salts for colours: fireworks. A festival with fireworks lasts half as long again and raises spirits more.

steel_mill.name: Steel mill
steel_mill.info: A Bessemer converter blows air through molten iron: steel for rails, locomotives and steam engines.

rolling_mill.name: Rolling mill
rolling_mill.info: Red-hot steel is rolled into rails: one rail lays one tile of track.

locomotive_works.name: Locomotive works
locomotive_works.info: Builds steam locomotives. Each locomotive in your stores runs as a train between two of your stations on the same track.

railway_station.name: Railway station
railway_station.info: A small store with a platform. Lay rails up to it (it joins the track touching its plot): two stations on the same track make a line, and your locomotives run trains between them, up to 40 goods a trip, for 1 coal a trip.
